title: Tech view: the tech time input field is hidden on work order lines
custom_preconds: 1. A user has a role with View mode set to Tech view and Work order lines View and Create & Edit.
custom_steps:
1. Open a work order and click into a line to edit.

evidence: UI (tech view): no tech-time input field rendered on the WO lines for this user (0 tech-time inputs found).
